title: Gingerbread Cake
description: My Thermomix take on Claudia Fleming's gingerbread cake — deeply spiced, impossibly moist, with a molasses backbone and a tender crumb that the TM6 mixes flawlessly every time.
intro: Claudia Fleming's gingerbread cake is the kind of recipe that makes bakers weep with joy — dark, sticky, fragrant with ginger and molasses. The Thermomix handles the batter in one bowl, no creaming required, and the result is that perfect tender crumb that tastes like a winter afternoon.
ingredients: 30 g fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped
Butter and flour for the tin
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (fan-forced 160°C). Butter and flour a 23 cm round cake tin.
Add the fresh ginger to the bowl and chop 10 sec / speed 8 until a fine paste forms.
Add the butter, molasses, brown sugar and hot water. Warm 3 min / 80°C / speed 3 until the butter melts and everything is smooth.
Add the egg and mix 10 sec / speed 4 until just combined.
Add the flour, ground ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda and salt. Mix 20 sec / speed 4, scraping down once halfway through, until the batter is smooth with no dry patches.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin. Bake in a preheated oven 45 min / 175°C oven / no speed until a skewer comes out with just a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin for 15 min, then turn out onto a wire rack. Best served warm or at room temperature with a dusting of icing sugar or a dollop of cream.
tips: Fresh ginger is worth the effort here — the jar stuff doesn't have the same fiery punch.
The batter will look very thin — that's normal. It sets in the oven.
Keeps beautifully for 3 days in an airtight container; the flavour deepens overnight.

faq.q: Can I use only ground ginger and skip the fresh?
faq.a: You can, but you'll lose the fresh bite. If skipping, add an extra teaspoon of ground ginger.

faq.q: Why is the batter so runny?
faq.a: Molasses-based cakes are thin batters — the low gluten development from the molasses keeps the crumb tender. It will set in the oven.

faq.q: Is this the original Claudia Fleming recipe?
faq.a: No. This is Chef Aly's independent Thermomix reinterpretation inspired by Claudia Fleming and gingerbread cake; it is not endorsed by or affiliated with the chef.
